purpose: Document Nagercoil's official local/state cadastral entry points and bounded anonymous service attempts without retaining unsafe land-record fields.
assessment: Kanniyakumari District Administration provides an official Nagercoil-linked land-record service page, and Tamil Nadu's official e-Services/TNGIS/TamilNilam materials document Patta/FMB/Chitta/TSLR, A-Register and urban land-survey-map routes. No safe anonymous parcel identifier plus full native polygon response was obtained. The unanswered or timed-out routes do not establish parcel absence.
